header: A cover on one side, what the reader will learn on the other
lead: Three or four icon points between the claim and the button, with a cover image that keeps a document's proportions rather than being cropped into a banner.
note: The element never gates the file: the button goes wherever it was pointed, so a link that looks ungated really is ungated.

takeaways.title: Up to six points
takeaways.text: Each an icon, a title and one sentence — the same unit as every feature grid in the catalog.

takeaways.title: Two to four columns
takeaways.text: The count is an editor's choice and the grid still reflows on the room it has.

takeaways.title: Cover or none
takeaways.text: Without an image the copy takes the whole band instead of leaving half of it empty.

takeaways.title: Sides swappable
takeaways.text: Reverse moves the cover across without changing the order the copy is read in.
